items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: No, I know Black Happy though. Yeah, he went to Spurrier and died over there.

ctx.x: Well, I ask him who some good drummers were in all this.

So who was some good drummers in them days? Good drummer. Bob Aang, Johnny, Great Happy, Black Happy. Let me see who else. Facial, you remember Facial? Yeah. Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo Bo…
Eddie Woods. Eddie Woods? Eddie Woods is Faso's name.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Black Happy. Say, who was the drummer? Black Happy. Uh. Well, ask him who was the drummer. Well, the doctor stopped Black Happy from playing.

ctx.x: Did he say it was Black Happy? I forgot. Yeah. Ask him who the drummer was.
Black Happy. Say, who was the drummer? Black Happy. Uh. Well, ask him who was the drummer. Well, the doctor stopped Black Happy from playing. Uh-huh. So, he had high blood pressure, too.
But he's working in the street with the Eureka.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: He was playing with us when... ...watched the blood together on Clownet. And Red Happy with him... You know, Black Happy, don't you?

ctx.x: What about Red Happy? He wasn't talking about Red Happy.

You remember Red Happy? Yeah. You remember Red Happy? He died in Chicago too didn't he? He was playing with us when... ...watched the blood together on Clownet. And Red Happy with him. He was terrible. Good drummer but... ...we'll be sure you know, like his soft music. Happy, how are you? Happy Cesar Martin, play loud. He quit sometimes, you know. He was terrible. I've been playing music around there when we were a kid. Great happy. You know, Black Happy, don't you? What's the good of the matter with him? What's…
Tell him he's with the Eureka Band still.
